# proxmox_node_ceph_config_value (Data Source)

Reads specific Ceph config values from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/cfg/value`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_config_value" "v" {
  node = "pve-1"
  keys = ["global:osd_pool_default_size"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `keys` (List of String)
- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `value` (String)
